title: Island Oysters Pop-Up
summary: Mark your calendars, @islandoysters is back Saturday, Nov. 22nd, and we’re already drooling. Their last visit? Legendary. Expect mountains of shells, oceans of flavour, and a newfound appreciation for oyster–beer pairings.
